notes: 2-channel digital wireless microphone receiver (DWX series), 1U rackmount. Ports confirmed via Sony's official Operating Instructions manual (Parts Identification, rear panel, page 14; Specifications table, page 42), accessed via ManualsLib mirror since pro.sony and sony-asia.com product/spec pages returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch. Two analog balanced XLR outputs (CH1/CH2) and two analog unbalanced 1/4" TS outputs (CH1/CH2) are combined per-channel in this listing since the manual treats "ANALOG BALANCED OUT 1/2" and "ANALOG UNBALANCED OUT 1/2" as connector pairs (×2 each) - modeled here as two ports per type (CH1, CH2). Digital AES/EBU output is provided in parallel on both one XLR-3 connector and one BNC connector (mono/combined, not per-channel per manual wording). ANTENNA a/b IN accept BNC, 50 ohm, with switchable antenna booster supply voltage (0V/9V/12V) - not modeled as a separate port. ANTENNA a/b OUT (BNC) allow daisy-chaining the antenna feed to additional DWR-R02D units and are included as bidirectional-adjacent RF passthrough outputs. REM ANT is a small connector for the optional ST (Synchronized Transmission) remote-antenna accessory; included as a low-confidence antenna-related port using BNC as closest connector id (exact connector type not confirmed in available manual excerpts). DC IN is rated 12V/1.6A but the exact physical connector style (barrel jack vs 4-pin XLR-DC) could not be definitively confirmed from available manual excerpts - one automated OCR summary described it as "(XLR)" but a later, more careful pass could not verify this; modeled as dc-barrel pending confirmation, flag for double-check against physical unit or full PDF pinout diagram if precision matters. No USB, Ethernet/LAN, or word-clock ports were confirmed in the verified spec table pass (an earlier OCR summarization pass hallucinated a LAN RJ-45 and WORD SYNC connector, likely bleeding in from a different Sony product's manual section during OCR/AI summarization; these are NOT included here since they could not be corroborated in the specifications table or in Sony's product marketing copy, which describes only XLR/BNC AES digital out, TS unbalanced out, and AC/DC power). No grades apply: BNC antenna/AES ports carry no stated bandwidth class, and analog XLR/TS outputs are not bandwidth-graded connector types per the taxonomy. Rack unit: 1U per Sony marketing copy ("two-channel rack-mountable (1U-size) receiver"). Region variants (e.g. DWR-R02D/42 for UC band, DWR-R02DN) may differ in RF band only, not physical I/O.
